rules.availability: never event_time + one bar by default: the dataset must declare what its timestamp means, and provider latency is added
rules.forward: a centred window, a negative shift or roll, a bfill or positional indexing anywhere on a path makes the output NON_CAUSAL
rules.transitive: locals and intermediates are resolved inside the defining symbol and helpers are followed where they can be traced; every path ends at a leaf or the output is UNRESOLVED
rules.unknown: one unfollowed call, one ambiguous helper or one cycle leaves the whole output UNRESOLVED
